quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

18 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: When can you cross a solid yellow line?

options.text: To pass another car going the same direction.

questions.explanation: Broken yellow lines can be crossed, but solid yellow lines cannot. You may only cross a solid yellow line when you are turning.

questions.question: What must you do when you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights?

options.text: Slow down but keep driving in your lane.
Pull to the right curb and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right curb and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear its siren, pull over to the right side of the road and stop right away.

questions.question: What must you do immediately when an emergency vehicle with a siren and/or flashing lights approaches you?

options.text: Pull to the right and stop.
Pull to the right and slow down.
Pull to the right and turn on your four-way flashers.
Stop and let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with lights, sirens, or other warning devices approaches you, drive to the right side of the road and stop right away.

questions.question: What is the safest way to drive in traffic?

options.text: Change your speed often to stay alert.
Drive with the flow of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other vehicles. Always drive with the flow of traffic and stay within the speed limit.

questions.question: When should you drive below the posted speed limit?

options.text: When anything makes driving conditions not perfect.
When you see a police car.
When entering a highway with other cars.
When you are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: When anything makes driving conditions not perfect.
questions.explanation: Drive below the speed limit when roads are wet or slippery, when you cannot see well, or when any other condition is not perfect. Even at the speed limit, you can be ticketed for driving too fast for the conditions.

questions.question: What should you do when a truck driver behind you wants to pass?

options.text: Keep your speed steady or go slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your speed steady or go slower.
questions.explanation: When a truck passes you, it is safer if you slow down a little and keep that speed steady. Never speed up while a truck is passing you.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady yellow traffic light?

options.text: Speed up to get through before the red light.
Keep driving because you have the right-of-way.
Slow down and stop, unless you are already in the intersection.
Check what the cars next to you are doing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop, unless you are already in the intersection.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means red is coming next. Stop unless you are already inside the intersection.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast on wet roads. You can reduce the risk by driving slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to avoid accidents.
Getting ahead of bad drivers to protect yourself.
Following the car ahead very closely.
Quickly changing lanes and weaving through traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to avoid accidents.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means noticing dangerous situations and taking action before an accident happens. It helps you avoid crashes with aggressive, careless, or unsafe drivers.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line on your side means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: How can you lower the risk of hydroplaning?

options.text: Do not speed when the roads are wet.
Use tires with proper air pressure.

questions.explanation: Hydroplaning occurs when your car slides on water between the tires and road. Low tire pressure, bad tread, and speeding on wet roads all increase hydroplaning risk.

questions.question: While backing, you should:

options.text: Open your door to see if it is safe to proceed.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: When backing up, turn your head to look through the rear window. Mirrors and sensors alone are not enough. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat.

questions.question: When you want to make a right turn, your car must be:

options.text: Near the center of the street.
Close to the left side of the street.
Close to the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection when you begin to turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Close to the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, move your car as far to the right as possible. Do not cut across lanes to make any turn.

questions.question: You may continue carefully through an intersection with a yellow light if:

options.text: There is an emergency vehicle crossing your lane.
You are already within the intersection when the light changes to yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already within the intersection when the light changes to yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you may continue through carefully.

questions.question: What is the first thing you should adjust when you get into a car to drive?
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first to be comfortable and see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: Lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are divided by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.

questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Look both ways before crossing tracks. Obey all signs and signals. Trains share the road with cars, pedestrians, and bicyclists.
